verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing claims it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite, with AI-powered automations to close books faster, so ERP integration is a first-party capability. That claim is a single thin line, and nothing shows the sync is real-time or bidirectional. Webhooks and the transaction API are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence the sync is real-time, evidence it is bidirectional (ERP back to Mercury), documentation of how journal entries are mapped and automated, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the ERP sync.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries

citations.quote: Sync with Quickbooks, Xero or NetSuite, and save hours with AI-powered automations to close your books faster.
